text.aria-label: Title text 'D10 (signed-MW Primary): day-ahead forecasts made at 09:00 UTC on one winter and one summer day. Line: median. Shades: 50% and 90% bands (widened 1.15). Dashed: actual. Blue: C0. Orange: C2.'
text.tspan: D10 (signed-MW Primary): day-ahead forecasts made at 09:00 UTC on one winter
and one summer day. Line: median. Shades: 50% and 90% bands (widened 1.15).
Dashed: actual. Blue: C0. Orange: C2.
